notes: context-fog-of-war bundle mapping for a live round folder (.sdlc/evals/rounds/<date>-<slug>/), T-0248. One dev proxy trace line (traces/<day>.jsonl, T-0151) is one model_request. conversationId is the line's catalogId: a trace line carries no probe-run identity, so turns partition by catalog (persona catalogs agent-ui--<persona>; admiral and lexicographer share the base catalog agent-ui on rounds 1 to 3). requestId is the line's `at` ISO time, unique per line in every committed round; it identifies the turn, it is not a causal join. includedChunkIds are trace.exemplarIds, the corpus exemplars framed into the system prompt; `complete` is not mapped because no field states that list is the full submitted context, so the omission detectors abstain. Not mappable in this vocabulary (kept as hashed artifacts): runs/*/report.json and fixture.json (they join to a trace line by `<day>.jsonl:<line>`, which no canonical event type can target), the routing block of T-0239 and later lines (sections, mini-skills and references are object lists or need a load state), retries and failure codes (no canonical event), and usage.
